title: Para-differential Rota-Baxter algebras and their free objects by Gröbner-Shirshov bases
summary: The algebraic formulation of the derivation and integration related by the First Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (FFTC) gives rise to the notion of differential Rota-Baxter algebra. The notion has a remarkable list of categorical properties, in terms of the existence of (co)extensions of differential and Rota-Baxter operators, of the lifting of monads and comonads, and of mixed distributive laws.
